exact_action_rule: action_type and expected tool name must match; expected argument dictionaries and missing_fields must exactly match when provided
invalid_output_rule: unparseable output, unknown action/tool, schema-invalid action, timeout, or missing action is invalid and incorrect
raw_model_scope: one actual Ollama model action per example through the existing Ollama adapter; no registered business tool execution in this phase
controller_scope: offline replay of the same frozen raw proposals through V2 and opt-in V4; replay does not execute tools or database operations
latency: wall-clock for actual model call plus parsing; report median and p95; action-only scope
provenance: internal synthetic labels; not independently human adjudicated
